entities.summary: Henriette-Julie de Murat was an aristocratic French writer of the late 17th century, associated with the Baroque Précieuses movement, and one of the leading members of the French Salons who created the fairy tale genre. She was considered to be part of les conteuses. Henriette-Julie de Murat was a authors & novelists from Brest (1670, Brest–1716-09-29).
